item.title: Epistemic (In)Justice in Transport Geography
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines epistemic justice and injustice within transport geography. It explores how knowledge about transport systems, mobility, and spatial practices is produced, validated, and disseminated, and investigates whose voices and perspectives are centered or excluded in transport research and policy-making.

Appel publié par Journal of Transport Geography. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
